args.document_title: 3M™ Fire Barrier Sealant IC 15WB+ Product Data Sheet
args.evidence_quote: Designed to prevent the spread of fire, smoke and noxious gas, 3M™ Fire Barrier Sealant IC 15WB+ is a one-part, gun-grade, latex-based, intumescent firestop sealant. This firestop sealant provides up to 3-hour fire protection in accordance with ASTM E 814 (UL 1479) and CAN/ULC S115.

args.revision_quote: No revision number found in document
args.evidence_quote: The SLLT LED Troffer is a versatile and energy-efficient lighting solution, specifically designed to replace traditional 1’x4’, 2’x2’, and 2’x4’ fluorescent fixtures in commercial and institutional settings. Ideal for use in offices, schools, and healthcare environments, the SLLT LED Troffer integrates seamlessly into drop ceilings, offering enhanced control and flexibility. Fully dimmable and white-tunable, the SLLT LED Troffer provides customizable lighting options. Its advanced wireless Bluetooth mesh control allows for effortless integration into modern building management systems, while its compatibility with motion sensors, timers, and daylight harvesting systems ensures optimal energy efficiency.
args.status_quote: No discontinuation notices found for SLLT LED Troffer Luminaire; product actively featured on manufacturer website with recent updates (March 20, 2026)
